body:
What is TopPlayers?

TopPlayers is a powerful and fully customizable Minecraft plugin that tracks, stores, and displays player statistics in a clean and modern way.

It allows server owners to create:
• advanced player profiles
• global leaderboards
• detailed statistics GUIs
• placeholder-based holograms
• custom & vanilla stat tracking

All fully configurable and optimized for performance.


✨ Key Features


[] ✔ Advanced Player Profile GUI with 50+ statistics
[] ✔ Global leaderboards (Top players per statistic)
[] ✔ Supports vanilla Minecraft stats and custom stats
[] ✔ Fully configurable GUI (titles, items, lore, icons, slots)
[] ✔ PlaceholderAPI support (for chat, TAB, holograms, scoreboards)
[] ✔ SQLite database (lightweight & fast)
[] ✔ Async data saving & loading (no lag)
[] ✔ Clean, modern GUI design
✔ Highly optimized for large servers
